schema.title: Response List Chains Api V1 Chains Get

post.description:
Add a set of settings to a chain: a fresh one, or a copy of one that exists.

Both are seeded from an entry's five sections and neither brings a report library - a
new set of settings has earned nothing yet. The new one is born switched off, so adding
one never moves which set of settings the chain is running.

patch.description:
Rename a set of settings. The id does not move with the label.

The id is in five primary keys and in every run key the chain has written, so moving it
would be a migration of the whole report library to change what a row reads. The label
is the part a human reads; this is the only part a rename touches.

delete.description:
Delete a set of settings and its whole report library. There is no undo.

Three gates, in the order a person meets them. The label typed back has to be the one on
the entry, because a double confirmation that a click can pass is not a confirmation.
The entry has to be one that may go at all, which `config.delete_config` refuses for the
default and for the live one. And no round of it may be in flight, because that round is
a worker reading rows this would delete out from under it.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api V1 Runs Get

post.description:
Stop a round that is still going. Idempotent, and never waits for the round.

A round is minutes of network on a worker thread, and an HTTP handler cannot reach into
that thread. So the request leaves a flag for the round to find at its next checkpoint,
and returns at once: what comes back is the row as it stands, which is `running` for
another second or two and then `cancelled` - the page already polls the row.

The one exception is a round nobody has started: nothing will ever read the flag, and the
scheduler starts every round it finds at `pending` again, so that one is settled here
instead of made to look like it is still waiting.

get.description: Everything the report page draws: batch strip, funnel, changes, cards,落选表.

schema.title: Response Get Reports Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Reports Get

get.description: SSE. Events: `status` on every transition, then `done`, `timeout` or `error`.

put.description:
Save a version, and make this set of settings the chain's live one.

Saving is where the page's dropdown commits: it shows which set of settings is being
edited, so this is the one write that can mean "and use it". A save that left the
previous one running would be a save whose effect the operator cannot see, which is the
one thing a settings page cannot afford to be.

post.description:
Run this round immediately with the settings in force.

Creating the row is not starting it. The ticker looks at the clock, so it would never
pick a manual round up - the button has to hand the round to the worker itself, or the
row sits at `pending` looking like it is still waiting for a slot.

Replay the latest snapshots against a candidate patch: who moves, and why.

Blocked on purpose, but not on the口径: those are decided and implemented. A
recompute would have to re-apply a patched payload to the round's own universe, and
the universe is not stored - only the candidates are. Re-scoring the candidates alone
would produce a diff against a smaller pool than the round actually ran, which is a
fabricated answer, and worse than no answer.

schema.title: Response List Lexicon Api V1 Lexicon Get

get.description: The shelf, newest kept first. Every row carries its card: the page draws cards.

schema.title: Response List Favorites Api V1 Favorites Get

post.description:
Keep the card this round wrote for this token, as the report page drew it.

Taken from report.assemble.cards rather than from the raw report payload: the page is
already drawn from that assembly (the new/continuing flag, the deltas against the round
before, the two weights), and freezing anything less would mean re-deriving those on
read - against a later round. The row itself is shaped by that same module, so the card a
reader keeps and the card a later round refreshes it with are one shape.

Collect a card that is already on file - the star on a searched token.

A searched card has no round to copy one from: the CA search already wrote it
(app/lookup.py). So this is the reader's star on a row that exists, and it only ever
turns that row's `kept` on. 404 when there is no row to collect, which is a stale page
rather than something worth inventing a card for.

delete.description:
Take one card off the shelf. A card that was already off it is not an error.

What "off the shelf" means depends on where the card came from. A round's card exists
only because it was collected, so unstarring it deletes the row. A searched card is also
the reader's own record of looking that address up - unstarring it puts the row back to
`kept = 0` instead, so it stays on 最近搜索 and can be collected again without paying for
the search twice.

post.description: Queue one CA search. Answers with the job to poll, not with the card.

get.description:
The newest search this app ran, so 运行结果 has something to fold on a first visit.

Declared above `/jobs/{job_id}` on purpose: FastAPI matches routes in the order they are
written, and the other one would read "latest" as a job id and answer 404.

schema.title: Response Read Latest Job Api V1 Lookup Jobs Latest Get

get.description: Where a queued search has got to, and the card once it has one.
What has been searched lately, newest first, cards and all - the page's own list.

schema.title: Response Recent Lookups Api V1 Lookup Recent Get

delete.description:
Empty 最近搜索 of the records that are only records.

Never a card on the shelf: a row the reader starred is a favourite, and the star is the
only write that ends that (8.8.4). A list that had nothing to drop answers false, which
is one answer rather than an error - the same way forgetting a card twice is not one.

Drop one record. A row that is not there is not an error, and neither is one the reader
starred - that row is a card on the shelf, and 搜索管理 greys it out rather than offering
a button that would silently do nothing.

put.description:
Save what changed, then answer the file as it now reads.

The whole form comes back rather than an acknowledgement: a save can leave a row looking
different from what was typed - a number, a box cleared back to its default, a credential
standing as a fingerprint - and the page has to draw what was written, not what it sent.

get.description: 最近的几笔改动 (2.8): 谁在什么时候把哪一格改成了什么。

schema.title: Response Read Audit Api V1 System Audit Get

post.description:
The model ids the endpoint says it serves, read with the page's unsaved rows.

A refusal is an answer rather than an error: the page prints the sentence beside the button
that asked for it, so a wrong key or an endpoint with no `/models` leaves the form as it was.
The list is a convenience either way - the box stays typeable, and a model the gateway does
not list is still a model it will answer with.

A really small real call per key: the writing path itself, not a reachable endpoint.

Reachability is not the question a person is asking when they press this - an endpoint
that answers 200 with an empty message is the failure this repo has already paid for once
(6.4.8). So the reading that comes back is whether text arrived. Every key is asked, not
just the first: the standby has never answered anything, and a round only meets it on the
day the primary is refused (8.9.7).

Whether the X session on this page still carries a search: one profile read, no query.

The same rule as the gateway's probes - the rows as they stand on screen, not the file - and
the same reason: an operator who had to save a cookie before finding out whether it works
would be storing it in order to test it. Nothing is written, and nothing is recorded: a
search spends a rate budget a round needs, so this asks the one cheap question that tells a
session from two strings that look like one.

get.description:
筛选栏自己的词表.

页面不认识任何一个类别: 它是画出来的, 不是写死的. 加一个类别只改 `feed/taxonomy.py`,
前端一个字节都不动 (CLAUDE.md 2.3.3).

全部动态 (scope=all) 与精选 (scope=curated), 按天分组.

两个视图共用一条路由和一份形状, 因为它们问的是同一批条目的两个问题: "窗口里有什么" 与
"其中哪些够得上精选". 分成两条路由, 两个形状很快就会各自长出对方没有的字段.

分页走游标 (`next_cursor`): 这一秒新来一条, OFFSET 会让后面的每一页都错位一次。读不懂的
游标报 422 而不是退回第一页 —— 退回第一页会让"翻到底"变成一个死循环。

热点榜: 同一批条目先聚成事件, 再按热度排.

排序在服务端, 因为热度是 `sources` (有几家独立来源在说) 折扣上时间算出来的, 而"几家"
这个数页面看不到也不该自己算.

读的是**写下来的那份榜** (5 分钟内的请求读同一份), 没有或过期才现算一份再落库
(snapshot_heat.hot_payload / AIHOT 的 `hot.rank` 每 5 分钟一趟): 一次请求算一遍, 卡片上
的名次和详情页的"榜内第 N 名"迟早会对不上.

主题页左栏的目录: 实体名录分组, 每组带一个窗口内的条数.

它不按类别分, 因为类别是"这条东西是什么" (每条恰好一个, 全部动态的筛选栏已经在用),
而这里是"这条东西牵了谁" (一条可以牵好几个, 也可以一个都不牵). 两个问题, 两份词表.

一条线上的条目, 按天分组 —— 主题页中栏那一列.

`topic` 走查询串而不是路径段: `BNB Chain` 这样的名字里有空格, 而路径段里出现空格之后,
每一种客户端都会各自决定怎么转义它一次.

一条的整页.

按 id 取, 不是把列表里那个对象原样传下来: 详情页要印的东西列表 payload 里没有, 而"传下来"
会让详情页依赖"用户是从哪个列表点进来的", 三页就长出三个形状.

一件事的整页.

名次在这里补: 它是"这件事在热点榜上排第几", 榜单的次序只有后端算得出来, 页面看不到.

源体检 (1.9): 每个源的名字、间隔、连续失败与最近一次抓取。

一个连续失败的源在页面上必须看得见 —— 只有 `fail_count` 一个数在库里,
没有读口的时候,"这个源三天没吐东西"就只能靠人去查表。

schema.title: Response Read Sources Api V1 Feed Sources Get

get.description:
金标评测 (5.22): 人工标好的那份样本, 与现在的规则对一遍。

读一下就算, 不写库也不调模型: 它量的是回归 —— 改了规则之后, 那些原本判对的
还对不对。对不上的一条一条列出来, 因为「不合格」比「合格率 91%」更能告诉人改哪里。

资格的名单 (5.5): 一共有哪几道门槛、各自问什么、为什么是这个口径。

它是一张**表**而不是一次判定: 判在 `eligibility.py` 一处做, 这里只把那一处读出来。

星标有效性 (5.18): 这些 id 里哪些还在、哪些已经不公开了。

星标存在浏览器里, 而一条东西可以在被星标之后下架。页面不能自己猜"它还在吧"。

schema.title: Response Read Availability Api V1 Feed Availability Get

get.description: v1 快照与增量 (5.14): `since` 之后的新条目 + 下一次要带的游标。

get.description: 给 agent 读的一份 (5.13): 比 v1 多正文的纯文本, 少版式字段。

get.description: 一条的 Markdown 导出 (5.17): 和页面同一套可见性与许可规则。

The issues of one kind that have been put out, newest first. No bodies: a list draws a
mark, a headline and a time, and nothing else.

The newest issue, so a first visit has something to draw.

Declared above `/editions/{edition_id}` on purpose: FastAPI matches routes in the order they

get.description: One issue, body and all.

现在是设防还是不设防, 以及这一枚 cookie 算不算登录。

页面拿它决定画不画那个密码框 —— 而不是让每一个请求自己去猜 401 的意思。

post.description: 答对口令换一枚 cookie。答错就是 401 —— 不告诉对方「差一点」还是「差很多」。

get.description:
管理台能改的那几个键 (5.12): 每一个都是这台机器本地的配置,
不是清单里的一行 (它们是 key, 进 git 就等于公开)。

put.description:
改管理台的几个键。空串 = 清掉这一个键 (而不是写一个空串进去)。
每一次写都落一条审计 —— 改口令这件事本该有人记得。

post.description:
换一枚图片代理的签名密钥 (5.9)。换完之前发出去的链接全部失效 ——
所以它是一个需要登录的动作, 不是一个本地的小技巧。

Read every source, work out what happened, and put out an issue.

Answers with the issue that is now on file, which is not always a new one: running the same
window twice answers with the issue the first run published (store/db.py `feed_edition_put`),
because a reader who already read this morning is not owed a second draft of it.

get.description: 人工归属决定 (4.8b): 哪些条被人钉住了、谁钉的、什么时候。

post.description:
记一条人工决定: 这一条不再自动归组, 只有显式「重新分组」才会再判它。

人的一票就是结论 —— 不先问「它现在归在哪」; 自动分组在查询那一侧已经排除它。

delete.description: 撤掉一条人工决定: 下一次自动分组再判它一遍。

schema.title: Response Drop Override Api V1 Feed Override Delete

get.description:
运维读口 (5.11): 定时活儿什么状态、最近几趟跑成什么样、抓取与审计的尾巴。

给值守的人和机器看的, 不是页面的一部分: 一条活儿坏掉, 只有这里回答得了
「它上一次跑在哪个槽、为什么没跑」。

精选台账 (5.6): 哪一条什么时候上过首页、又什么时候下来了。

给一个 `item_id` 就只看那一条的历史 —— 它是跟着定时的一趟写的 (jobs 'selected-ledger'),
而不是请求这一下现算的。
出刊节奏与两道预算 (8.6 / 3.4)。出刊那三行留空 = 这一期不出, 到点出的是刚过去的那一期。

put.description:
存下改动, 然后把文件现在的样子答回去。

整份表单回传而不是一个「已保存」: 一次保存可能让某一格看起来和输入的不一样
(一个时刻被写回 `08:00`, 一格清成 0), 页面要画的是写进去的东西, 不是发出去的东西。
改这个文件不用重启 —— 每一轮 tick 现读一次 (见 `pipeline.py`)。

get.description:
MCP 出口 (routes/mcp) 的人读版说明: 有哪些工具、各要什么参数。

真正的协议在 POST 上。这一条存在是因为一个只能用 curl 的出口
不是一个能被人检查的出口。

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0: initialize / tools/list / tools/call / ping。只读, 不写库、不调模型。

get.description: 签名图片代理 (5.9)。未签名 / 签名错 / 过期一律 403, 一个字节都不去上游取。

schema.title: Response Og Og  Item Id  Get

ActionOut.title: ActionOut
ActionOut.description:
A button a group carries. What it does is the page's business; what it says is not.

The label travels with it (2.3.3), and the id is the one word the page does act on - it is
the map from a name to a handler, which is behaviour and belongs to the page. A group with
no actions draws no strip.

ChainConfigDetailOut.title: ChainConfigDetailOut
ChainConfigDetailOut.description: One set of settings, with the size of what deleting it would destroy.

ChainConfigIn.title: ChainConfigIn
ChainConfigIn.description:
Add a set of settings: a fresh one, or a copy of one that exists.

`label` is what the dialog had in it. Blank means "use the naming rule" - `配置 N` for a
new one, `<源> 副本` for a copy - which is what the page prefills anyway.

ChainConfigOut.title: ChainConfigOut
ChainConfigOut.description:
One set of settings on a chain, as a switcher needs to list it.

The口径 themselves are read one at a time through `/settings`; this is the name, the
switch, and whether the entry can be taken away at all.

DeleteIn.title: DeleteIn
DeleteIn.description:
The name typed back by whoever asked for the delete.

A delete that cannot be undone gets a gate a click cannot pass by accident: the page
makes the human type the label, and this is that same word arriving here. A mismatch is
a refusal rather than a shrug, because the only caller that gets it wrong is one that
did not mean it.

FavoriteIn.title: FavoriteIn
FavoriteIn.description: A card to keep: the round it came from, and which of that round cards.

FavoriteOut.title: FavoriteOut
FavoriteOut.description:
One card on file for a token: collected, or a record of a CA search for it.

A copy rather than a reference, on purpose: a report row is deleted with its round, and
a whole report library can be dropped, while a card the reader holds on to has to stay
readable. It is also why `config_id` is not part of the key - a card can come from a
chain this app does not screen, so the table is keyed by (chain_id, ca) alone. It is a
value: the set of settings the round ran under, for the line the card's foot prints.

Two kinds of row answer to this, and the reader only sees the difference on the card's
foot: a round's card carries `origin_run_id` and `config_id`, and a CA search's carries
neither (`origin = 'search'`, no score - there is no pool to rank in, app/lookup.py). A
round that writes one of these tokens again replaces the payload in place
(report/assemble.py `refresh_kept`), so `origin_run_id` / `origin_label` move forward
while `saved_at` stays at the moment the row was first put here.

FeedAdminSessionOut.title: FeedAdminSessionOut
FeedAdminSessionOut.description:
管理台的开关 (5.12): 设不设防, 以及这一个请求算不算登录。

两个都要回答 —— 只回后一个的话, 页面在没配口令时看不出自己是不是正在裸奔。

FeedAdminSettingOut.title: FeedAdminSettingOut
FeedAdminSettingOut.description:
一个本地键在页面上的样子: 名字、配没配、以及一个掩码。

`masked` 而不是明文: 这几个键都是密钥, 而一个能在页面上读出来的密钥
就不再是密钥。页面要的只是「这一格空不空」。

FeedCategoryOut.title: FeedCategoryOut
FeedCategoryOut.description:
筛选栏上的一个类别: 它的名字, 以及这一类在当前这批里有多少条.

`section` 是它在一份刊物里归到哪一节 —— 那是类别的属性, 不是页面的属性, 所以它跟着
类别走 (日报还没做, 见 DESIGN.md 8).

FeedChannelOut.title: FeedChannelOut
FeedChannelOut.description:
筛选栏上的一路: 它的键, 以及这一路在当前这批里有多少条.

`all` / `news` / `x` / `firstParty` 由后端给 (AIHOT 的 `CHANNEL_KEYS`): 页面不认识
任何一路, 加一路只改 `feed/rules.py`, 前端一个字节都不动.

FeedCoverageOut.title: FeedCoverageOut
FeedCoverageOut.description:
写作站的覆盖率 (2.3b): 每一档各有多少条。

档名就是 `llm_stage` (没问过的是 `none`); 不合并成一个百分比 —— 卡在哪一步看得见。

FeedDayOut.title: FeedDayOut
FeedDayOut.description: 一天. 日期与星期是这一组的头, 条数是右边那个数.

FeedDisplayTagOut.title: FeedDisplayTagOut
FeedDisplayTagOut.description: 卡片上的一格角标: 印什么字, 以及点不点得动.

FeedEditionOut.title: FeedEditionOut
FeedEditionOut.description:
One issue.

`kind` and `key` are the period it is about: `key` is a name a reader recognises
(`2026-10-03` / `2026-W40` / `2026-10`), which is why the page does not derive one - a week
number cannot be recovered from a timestamp without re-implementing ISO weeks.

`seen` and `entries` are different numbers on purpose: the window held `seen` records and
`entries` of them were worth printing. A quiet morning is an issue that read four hundred
things and printed three, which is a finding - not the same screen as a run that failed.

FeedEditionRowOut.title: FeedEditionRowOut
FeedEditionRowOut.description:
One issue in the list, without its body: a list draws a mark, a title and a time.

`headline` and `issue_number` are here rather than derived on the page for the same reason
they are stored: the list loads the last few dozen issues, and neither "what was this issue
about" nor "which issue is this" can be read off a truncated list.

FeedEligibilityOut.title: FeedEligibilityOut
FeedEligibilityOut.description: 资格的全体 (5.5): 名单 + 那两条数字线。

FeedEvalAxisOut.title: FeedEvalAxisOut
FeedEvalAxisOut.description: 金标评测里一个轴的成绩 (5.22): 这一类判断对了几条。

FeedEvalMissOut.title: FeedEvalMissOut
FeedEvalMissOut.description: 一条没对上的样本: 人标的是什么, 机器答的是什么, 以及为什么这样标。

FeedEvalOut.title: FeedEvalOut
FeedEvalOut.description: 金标评测 (5.22): 人工标好的样本与现在的规则对一遍的结果。

FeedEventOut.title: FeedEventOut
FeedEventOut.description:
One thing that happened, and how many independent parties said so.

`sources` is the count everything downstream is built on, and it is deliberately not
`len(discoveries)`: one wire service reprinted nine times is one party, and a page that
showed nine would make a story look hot when it is not. `heat` is that count discounted by
how long ago the last word came in.

`judgement` is the reading pass's answer, and it travels with the event rather than being
baked into the text: `certainty` is the one field a reader must be able to see, because a
fact and a rumour of one look identical once they are summarised.

FeedFaceOut.title: FeedFaceOut
FeedFaceOut.description: 参与者头像 (AIHOT 的 `Faces.tsx`): 一家一枚, 没图用首字母。

FeedFlashOut.title: FeedFlashOut
FeedFlashOut.description: 纸尾那一行快讯 (AIHOT 的 `flashes`): 只够一行的一条, 点开才是详情.

FeedGateOut.title: FeedGateOut
FeedGateOut.description: 门槛本身 (5.5): 叫什么、问什么、为什么是这个口径。

FeedGateResultOut.title: FeedGateResultOut
FeedGateResultOut.description: 一道门槛在**这一条**上的结论 (5.5). `ok` 是 null = 这一层答不上来, 不是"没过"。

FeedHeatPointOut.title: FeedHeatPointOut
FeedHeatPointOut.description: 热度曲线上的一格 (AIHOT `heatSeries` 的 `HeatPoint`): 一个小时的指数与参与者家数。

FeedHighlightOut.title: FeedHighlightOut
FeedHighlightOut.description: 这一期的要点一条 (AIHOT 的 `highlights`): 标题、一句摘要、几家在说.

FeedItemDetailOut.title: FeedItemDetailOut
FeedItemDetailOut.description:
一条的整页.

继承列表那一行而不是另写一份: 同一件事写两遍, 迟早有一边多一个字段, 而读的人不知道哪边
是对的. 这里只加**只有详情页看得见**的那几样.

FeedItemOut.title: FeedItemOut
FeedItemOut.description:
One source saying one thing, exactly as it was read.

The raw record, not a summary of it: an issue is allowed to be wrong about what a thing
means, but it must never be wrong about who said it and when. This is the shape it can be
checked against.

FeedItemsOut.title: FeedItemsOut
FeedItemsOut.description: 全部动态 (scope=all) 与精选 (scope=curated) 共用的一份答案.

FeedJudgementOut.title: FeedJudgementOut
FeedJudgementOut.description:
What the reading pass decided about one event.

A model rather than a bare dict (the rule this file opens with): an untyped answer reaches
the page as `unknown`, the page has to guess, and guessing is how a label ends up hardcoded
in the frontend and drifting from the rule that produced it.

`certainty_label` is the whole reason this is a contract. An event two parties reported and
an event one party reported read identically once each is one sentence long, and this is the
field that keeps them from looking identical on the page.

FeedLedgerRowOut.title: FeedLedgerRowOut
FeedLedgerRowOut.description: 精选台账上的一笔 (5.6): 这一条什么时候进的首页 / 什么时候下来的.

FeedListItemOut.title: FeedListItemOut
FeedListItemOut.description:
列表里的一行, 全部动态与精选共用.

这是**条目**不是事件: 一个条目有唯一的一个来源、唯一的一个时刻、唯一的一个类别, 而这三样
正是一个读者扫列表时看的东西. 要读"多少家都在说", 看热点榜.

`score` 是这一行的分量 (0-100), `reason` 是"为什么值得看", `summary` 是它说了什么.
三者都随行走, 页面不再查任何地方.

FeedMentionOut.title: FeedMentionOut
FeedMentionOut.description: 复合分析提到的一件事 (4.9b): 事件 id、标题与它挂在哪个事实上.

FeedMetricOut.title: FeedMetricOut
FeedMetricOut.description:
报头上的一个数, 连同它旁边那个词.

The word is not decoration and it is not the page's to write: "个来源" means "independent
parties after dedupe by source_id", which is a fact about a rule in `heat.py`. A page that
wrote its own word would be restating that rule a second time, and it would drift.

FeedOpsOut.title: FeedOpsOut
FeedOpsOut.description: 运维读口 (5.11): 定时活儿的健康、最近几趟活儿与抓取、最近的审计。

FeedOtherReportOut.title: FeedOtherReportOut
FeedOtherReportOut.description:
同一件事里, 别家还怎么说过它 —— 卡片上「另有 N 家信源报道」展开后的那一行.

署名是**来源**不是作者: 折叠行数的是"几家在说", 所以这一列只到来源为止.

FeedOutlineOut.title: FeedOutlineOut
FeedOutlineOut.description:
正文目录的一条 (AIHOT 的 `OutlineEntry`): 锚点、标题、层级.

锚点是后端注进正文的 (`sec-N`), 所以页面点目录只要滚到那个 id 上, 不必自己认标题.

FeedOverrideIn.title: FeedOverrideIn
FeedOverrideIn.description: 人写下的一条决定: 这一条不许自动归组。actor 与 reason 是追查的两个键。

FeedOverrideRowOut.title: FeedOverrideRowOut
FeedOverrideRowOut.description: 一条人工归属决定 (4.8b). 自动分组读到就跳过这条, 只有显式「重新分组」才清。

FeedQuotedOut.title: FeedQuotedOut
FeedQuotedOut.description:
被引的那条帖子 (AIHOT 的 `XPostView.quoted`)。

`translation` 是给读者看的那一份 (3.6): 别人的原话单独走一遍翻译, 不是正文那一段的译文。
它为空就是还没译上, 页面只印原文.

FeedSettingsIn.title: FeedSettingsIn
FeedSettingsIn.description: A patch keyed by each row's own path in the file (`llm.maxItems`).

FeedStoryDetailOut.title: FeedStoryDetailOut
FeedStoryDetailOut.description:
一件事的整页.

`items` 是卡上那份"谁在说", `days` 是同一批报道按天的分组 —— 两个投影来自同一份列表,
算在同一个函数里, 所以不可能对不上; 页面读 `days`.

FeedStoryItemOut.title: FeedStoryItemOut
FeedStoryItemOut.description: 热点榜里, 一条故事下面挂着的一条来源.

FeedStoryOut.title: FeedStoryOut
FeedStoryOut.description:
热点榜上的一条.

`sources` 是整件事见过的独立来源数, `participants` 是**窗口里**还在说的家数, 其中
`source_count` 家是发布源、`signal_count` 家是讨论源 (页面印的"来源数"是 `source_count`:
讨论帖不是"谁在报这件事"). `heat_index` 是热度指数 (10 倍值, 一位小数), `series` 是榜单
那一刻往前 24 小时的 25 个**小时**格子, 缺的小时补 `null` —— 读的是落库的快照, 不是每个
请求重算一遍 (snapshot_heat). `trend` 是五态走势 (new/unknown/up/down/flat), `trend_pct` 是
它那一眼的具体涨幅 —— `None` 表示那时它还不在. `hot_badges` 是标题上那几枚小标签, 可以同时
带 `surge` 和 `new` (heat.badges).

FeedStoryRefOut.title: FeedStoryRefOut
FeedStoryRefOut.description:
关联事件那一栏的一行 (AIHOT 的 `StoryRef`): 另一件事的 id、标题与关系词。

`relation` 是枚举 (`storyline` / `related`), `relation_label` 是它在这一页上的中文 ——
词由后端给, 页面不认识那个枚举 (CLAUDE.md 2.3.3).

FeedTaxonomyOut.title: FeedTaxonomyOut
FeedTaxonomyOut.description:
筛选栏自己的词表: 类别、主题标签、实体名录.

页面拿它画筛选栏, 所以类别一个也不认识也画得出来 —— 加一个类别只改后端.

FeedTimelineDayOut.title: FeedTimelineDayOut
FeedTimelineDayOut.description: 一天. 和列表页的按天分组同一个形状, 理由也一样: 日期是这套语言的写法, 由后端写.

FeedTimelineItemOut.title: FeedTimelineItemOut
FeedTimelineItemOut.description: 事件时间线上的一行. 有 id, 所以点得进去 —— 时间线是去条目详情页的另一个入口.

FeedTopicGroupOut.title: FeedTopicGroupOut
FeedTopicGroupOut.description: 左栏的一段. `name` 是页面上那行小标题 (链与协议 / 交易所 / 机构与监管).

FeedTopicItemsOut.title: FeedTopicItemsOut
FeedTopicItemsOut.description:
一个实体名下的条目, 按天分组.

与 `FeedItemsOut` 同源 (`by_day`), 少了筛选栏那几样: 左栏就是筛选栏, 这里不需要第二份
类别计数. `topic` 原样带回, 所以页面不必记住自己刚才问的是哪条线.

FeedTopicRowOut.title: FeedTopicRowOut
FeedTopicRowOut.description:
主题页左栏的一行: 一个实体, 以及它在窗口里有多少条.

`id` 就是名录里的名字 (`Binance` / `BNB Chain`), 因为它已经是唯一的, 再编一个 id 只是
多一处能对不上的东西. 页面拿它当 URL 的一部分, 所以它必须稳 —— 改词表里的写法就是改网址.

FeedTopicsOut.title: FeedTopicsOut
FeedTopicsOut.description:
主题页左栏的目录.

`window_days` 是那句「近 N 天」里的 N. 由后端给而不是页面写死 30: 窗口的长短是一条
规则 (`views.TOPIC_HOURS`), 规则改了词要跟着改, 而页面不认识那条规则 (CLAUDE.md 2.3.3).

FeedXViewOut.title: FeedXViewOut
FeedXViewOut.description: X 这一条在卡片上的几格 (AIHOT 的 `XPostView`)。不是 X 的条目没有这一个对象。

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description:
One CA search, as the page polls it.

A job rather than a synchronous answer, because the search is minutes long and a page
that shows which stage it is on needs somewhere to read that from. `row` is the stored
card once the status is `done` - the same row the shelf and the recent list read, so a
searched card cannot be two different cards depending on how the page got it.

JobStageOut.title: JobStageOut
JobStageOut.description:
One row of a search's step list: what the stage is called and where it has got to.

The four states are the ones a round's step list draws too (pending / run / done /
failed), so the two panels cannot disagree about what a stopped stage looks like.
`seconds` is filled the moment the stage ends and stays empty until then.

LabelIn.title: LabelIn
LabelIn.description: The new name for a set of settings. Only the label moves; the id never does.

LibraryOut.title: LibraryOut
LibraryOut.description: How much one set of settings has, for the dialog that asks before deleting it.

LookupIn.title: LookupIn
LookupIn.description:
An address to search. The chain is not part of the ask: an address implies it, and the
reader typing one does not necessarily know which chain it is on (`app/lookup.py`
`resolve` answers that from the feed, deepest chain first).

PoolOut.title: PoolOut
PoolOut.description: One pool the token trades in, as the chain feed lists it.

SettingsIn.title: SettingsIn
SettingsIn.description: A partial patch of dotted-path leaves; empty means "nothing changed".

SystemFormOut.title: SystemFormOut
SystemFormOut.description:
系统设置: this machine's own wiring - the LLM endpoint, the X session, the log level.

The blocks are a chain's 设定 blocks on purpose: one shape, so the two pages are drawn by
the same renderer and a row cannot mean one thing here and another there. `path` is the
file the rows are written to, which is the one thing this page has and a chain's does not.

SystemIn.title: SystemIn
SystemIn.description: A patch keyed by each row's own path in the file (`llm.base_url`).

SystemModelsOut.title: SystemModelsOut
SystemModelsOut.description:
What `/models` answered, and which row the answer is for.

`apply_to` travels so the page can offer the list on the right row without learning a key
name - the same reason the rows themselves arrive composed (8.9.1).

SystemTestLineOut.title: SystemTestLineOut
SystemTestLineOut.description: One key's probe: the row it came from, and what the gateway answered it.

SystemTestOut.title: SystemTestOut
SystemTestOut.description: One small real call per configured key, in the order a round would try them (8.9.7).

SystemXOut.title: SystemXOut
SystemXOut.description:
Whether the X session still works, in the client's own words (8.9.10).

One sentence rather than 测试连接's line per key: there is one session, and it either is
logged in or says why it is not.
